title: AttackEval: How to Evaluate the Effectiveness of Jailbreak Attacking on Large Language Models
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The analysis centered on creating a framework to evaluate jailbreak attack effectiveness in general scenarios.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on evaluating the effectiveness of jailbreak prompts across 13 general categories of harmful content, such as 'Illegal Activity', 'Hate Speech', and 'Malware Generation'.
